source.source_locator: 教則 第3章 3.1.2(3)2)b「飛行日誌の携行及び記載」（教則表示ページ23 / PDF viewer 28）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 特定飛行で携行する飛行日誌は紙・電子いずれでもよいが、必要時に速やかに参照・提示できる状態にする。
evidence.tested_misconception: 電子データで保存していれば、現場で速やかに表示できなくても携行要件を満たす。
evidence.reasoning_path: special flight -> choose log medium -> ensure immediate practical access/presentation

collision.note: Tier A。Q042/Q111/Q211は日誌の種類・携行等を問うが、媒体自由と速やかな参照・提示可能性を組み合わせた条件は直接問っていない。

independent_review.rationale: 3.1.2(3)2)b explicitly permits paper or electronic flight logs while requiring prompt practical reference/presentation. Q042 tests log record categories and Q111 carriage, so medium freedom plus accessibility is a distinct proposition.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the quality-preserving 400-question contract to the B7 Chapter 3 Rules set. All 15 Tier A candidates test explicit source propositions not represented by the current 215-question accepted/source-verified canonical bank. The five Tier B candidates C001, C003, C008, C013 and C015 remain materially distinct through source-defined flight-phase, authority/exception, operation-subtype, response-sequence or moving-vehicle boundaries. None is retained as wording-only variation, none relies on a subsection marked 〔一等〕, and none is accepted merely to fill a numeric quota.
